subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 06, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 06, 2026**

**Top Development:**

Grml 2026.09 released: "Hä" Edition

The Grml team has released version 2026.09, code-named "Hä". This new release includes various updates and improvements, making it a great time to explore the Grml community and learn from their experiences.

**Community News:**

The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to the project, and we're grateful for their efforts. If you're interested in joining the community, please visit our Discord server at https://discord.acreetionos.org.

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can easily write AcreetionOS images to a USB drive from any operating system? Our AcreetionMediaWriter tool makes it simple to create a bootable USB drive, allowing you to try AcreetionOS without modifying your existing system. You can find more information and download the tool from our website.

That's all for this week's newsletter. Stay tuned for more updates and news from the AcreetionOS community!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
